confirmed_blocking.summary: FR-004 stall cap never halts a real worktree run. Issue `commit` defaults to worktree HEAD, and every writer call (ledger-add, issue-add) commits state, which moves HEAD. Consecutive partial returns never share a commit, so `consecutive_no_commit` stays at 1.
confirmed_blocking.evidence: ENG-1, ENG-18, FR-004. `cmd_issue_add` (line 802) and `overrun_issue` (line 918) set `record["commit"] = worktree_head(worktree)`. `commit_worktree` then makes a `factory: ...` commit. `stall_rule` (line 725) breaks on any differing commit. Reviewers reproduced distinct commits per call and `halt: false` after 3-4 calls. SKILL.md never passes `--commit`. The only stall test hard-codes `--commit aaa0001`.
confirmed_blocking.fix: Add one helper that returns the latest non-`factory:` commit (the last work commit). Use it in `cmd_issue_add` and `overrun_issue`. Add a test of three `--partial-return` writes without `--commit` that expects `halt: true` on the third. Add a case where a work commit between writes resets the count.
